# Poker Coach AI

> AI-powered poker training assistant for screenshot-based hand analysis, strategy learning, and browser-extension workflows.

## Canonical site
- https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/

## Key pages
- Home: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/
- Web App: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/app
- Browser Extension Guide: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/extension-guide
- Poker Wiki: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/wiki
- Poker Spots: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/spots
- Poker Ranges: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/ranges
- FAQ: https://poker-coach-ai.replit.app/faq

## Product summary
Poker Coach AI helps players review poker screenshots and get structured recommendations (fold/check/call/raise/all-in), with confidence and reasoning. The project includes a web app plus Chrome/Firefox extensions.

## API usage notes
- Extensions can be configured with a custom API server URL.
- Extensions also support a user-provided Gemini API key for independent usage and billing control.

## Content focus / entities
- Texas Hold'em strategy
- GTO-inspired recommendations
- Pot odds, stack depth, position
- Browser extension UX for hand review
